title: CONV-001: consolidate three duplicate CAM Loop definitions onto one canonical type
intent: Replace three copy-pasted Loop(BaseModel) definitions with a single canonical definition in app/schemas/cam_geometry.py, imported or re-exported by all three historical owners so every access path resolves to one class object. Promotes Consolidation Lab investigation LAB-013 work package WP-GEOM-3 (mechanical A1 duplication, B1 drift risk) into a bounded, behavior-invariant production change.

source_authority.note: Consolidation Lab evidence/decision/proposal records live in the separate Lab repository and are deliberately NOT committed here; a closure packet is carried back to the Lab after merge.

out_of_scope: Any change to DXF output, coordinate precision, router paths, persistence formats, or frontend geometry types
Any broader geometry-contract unification or DXF-as-IR vs canonical-document decision

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds services/api/app/schemas/cam_geometry.py owning the single canonical Loop (pts: List[Tuple[float, float]]). Removes the three duplicate class Loop(BaseModel) definitions: adaptive_schemas.py:50 and blueprint_cam_bridge_schemas.py:14 become compatibility re-exports of the canonical type, and contour_reconstructor.py:52 becomes a direct import. Drops the now-unused Tuple import from the two schema modules. Drops 'class Config: arbitrary_types_allowed = True', which existed only on the contour_reconstructor copy. Adds tests/cam/test_loop_canonicalization.py (50 tests) asserting single class identity, constructor/validation/coercion/serialization parity against verbatim replicas of both pre-change definitions, geometry parity, live downstream CAM parity, and an AST guard that exactly one 'class Loop' definition exists across app/cam, app/schemas and app/routers.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: This is not a formatting or no-op change: it removes three independently-editable definitions of the same wire contract and collapses them to one class object, eliminating the drift risk LAB-013 classified as B1. Structural identity is part of the delta — before this patch, isinstance/identity checks across the adaptive, blueprint-bridge and contour-reconstruction paths compared three distinct classes; after it they compare one. The AST guard is new enforcement that prevents a fourth copy reappearing in the authorized scope.
diff_articulation.behavior_invariance_evidence: behavior_change is 'none' and is proven, not asserted. The test module holds verbatim replicas of both pre-change definitions (the plain one, and the arbitrary_types_allowed variant) and asserts the canonical class matches them on: field set and annotation, required-ness, int-to-float coercion, list-to-tuple coercion, malformed-point and nonnumeric rejection including pydantic error codes, empty-loop acceptance, mutability, equality, model_dump, model_dump_json, JSON round-trip, and JSON schema. arbitrary_types_allowed was configuration residue — the model declares no arbitrary field types — and dropping it changed no accepted input, rejected input, or serialized output.

files.intent: New canonical owner of the shared CAM Loop contract. Placed in app/schemas/ because it is a leaf package (imports only from itself and sg_spec), so app/cam/ and app/routers/ can both consume it without an import cycle.

Duplicate Loop definition removed; becomes a compatibility re-export of the canonical type. Loop remains in __all__ so existing star-imports and the four downstream consumers (project_adapter, adaptive/dxf_router, rmos/mvp_router, vision/segmentation_router) are unaffected. Unused Tuple import dropped.

Duplicate Loop definition removed; becomes a compatibility re-export because routers/blueprint_cam/extraction.py imports Loop from this module. No __all__ is added — the module never declared one, and a restrictive __all__ would hide its other public schemas from star-imports. Unused Tuple import dropped.

Duplicate Loop definition removed; direct import of the canonical type. This was the only copy carrying 'class Config: arbitrary_types_allowed = True', which is not propagated — see diff_articulation.behavior_invariance_evidence. ReconstructionResult.loops and the loop-building path at line ~388 now consume the canonical class.

New. 50 tests: ownership/AST duplicate guard, class identity across all three historical paths plus four downstream consumers, import-cycle smoke, constructor and validation parity against verbatim replicas of both pre-change definitions, serialization and round-trip parity, geometry parity (vertex order, closure, orientation, bounds) over three fixtures, and live downstream CAM parity through two real DXF entry points.
